## Who We Are

The Flower Club is a full-service creative agency operating at the intersection of culture and commerce.
We serve Fortune 500 brands, independent artists, startups, and cultural organizations.
Based in Charlotte, NC. Active in Miami FL, New York NY, and Los Angeles CA.

## What We Do

- AI Audits & Consulting (from $2,500 — paid diagnosis of where a business loses money, scoped by complexity)
- AI System Builds (from $4,500 — intake, follow-up, scheduling, reporting automation)
- AI-Powered Digital Employees (monthly retainers from $2,500)
- The Club — AI concierge membership (retained advisory, vendor vetting, quarterly re-audits)
- Web Design & Custom Development (conversion-focused, custom-coded)
- Brand Identity & Logo Design
- Brand Activations & Experiential Marketing
- AI Animation & Motion Design, Video Production
- Graphic Design, Content Creation, Social Media

## Who We Serve

Owner-operated businesses ($1M–$20M): med spas, law firms, manufacturers, dental and medical practices — plus Fortune 500 brands and artists for creative work.

## Notable Clients

Maker's Mark, Red Bull, Bacardi, Rémy Martin, Courvoisier, Popeyes, Febreze, Def Jam Recordings

## Key Stats

- 150+ brand events produced
- 50+ brands worked with
- Fortune 500 to independent artists

## Cities Served

Charlotte NC (headquarters), Miami FL, New York NY, Los Angeles CA, Nationwide
